item: sweep_pr_number.py calls the ledger's fence rule and sweeps #PRNUMBER
summary: After Plan's #1643 made ledger_fold.outside_fences the ledger's one fence rule, the sweep script still toggled on any fence-like line, so it refused files check accepts, accepted one check refuses, and silently rewrote a ~~~ block quoted inside a backtick block. sweep_markdown now calls ledger_fold.outside_fences and _INLINE_CODE and names the line an unclosed fence opened at; a #PRNUMBER rule turns PR #PRNUMBER into PR #<n>; a csv refs cell is judged by ledger_shipped.REFS_PLACEHOLDER (a pending WORD, so 'depending on #1637' is not refused); a drift guard goes red when ledger_fold._PLACEHOLDER learns a token the sweep has no rule for. 20 tests are red on the old script; 61 of 61 mutants are killed.
